categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing AoLian Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in automotive electronic components manufacturing, focusing on power electronics control, body electronics control, and new energy system control. Key products include electronic throttle pedal assemblies, shift controllers, low-temperature start devices, electronic throttle valves, electromagnetic solenoids, urea heating pipes, automotive air conditioning controllers, automotive interior rearview mirrors, vehicle controllers, multi-in-one controllers, battery management systems, and specialized vehicle power systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent R&D and synchronous development with vehicle manufacturers, leveraging advanced technologies such as 2D patch Hall sensors, ultrasonic welding, electromagnetic simulation, and software/hardware integration. It maintains a comprehensive manufacturing process covering design, mold making, injection molding, SMT patching, assembly, and testing, adhering to IATF16949:2016 quality management standards. The company also holds multiple patents and certifications, including CNAS laboratory accreditation and product testing approvals from major automakers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major domestic automotive manufacturers including passenger car brands like Changan, FAW Group, Geely, BYD, SAIC-GM, JAC, and GAC, as well as commercial vehicle clients such as Beiqi Foton, Sinotruk, Shaanxi Auto, Dongfeng Commercial Vehicle, and FAW Jiefang. It also caters to new energy vehicle manufacturers including BYD, GAC Aion, Zeekr, Leapmotor, and XPeng. The products are used in both passenger and commercial vehicles, with a growing focus on new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, with significant revenue generated from regions including East China, Northeast China, South China, North China, Central China, Southwest China, and Northwest China. The company’s registered and operational headquarters are located in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing AoLian operates mainly as a midstream automotive parts supplier, manufacturing and supplying electronic components directly to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and vehicle assembly plants. It engages in direct sales to customers and participates in the automotive supply chain by providing critical electronic control modules and components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening its automotive electronics core business, accelerating product innovation and technology upgrades aligned with electrification, intelligence, and lightweight trends in the automotive industry. It prioritizes R&D in new energy vehicle components, including vehicle controllers, multi-in-one controllers, and battery management systems. The company also emphasizes cost reduction, efficiency improvements, and talent development to enhance competitiveness and profitability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive electronic components to OEMs and automotive suppliers. The company follows a make-to-order production model based on customer orders and forecasts, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also earns income from government subsidies and occasional investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a specialized high-tech automotive electronics supplier with strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio. It holds a competitive position by serving leading domestic automakers and new energy vehicle manufacturers, leveraging its technology innovation and quality control to maintain market share amid intense industry competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 440 million, a 9.85% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 8.5 million. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 900 million with net assets around RMB 708 million. The company experienced challenges due to price reductions, order delays, and shifts in business structure but continues to invest over 10% of revenue in R&D to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing AoLian emphasizes its comprehensive in-house R&D and manufacturing capabilities, strict quality control, and ability to customize products to meet stringent OEM requirements. Its products are recognized for functionality, reliability, and safety, supporting domestic substitution of imported automotive parts. The company’s focus on electrification and intelligent vehicle components, combined with its integration across the value chain, provides differentiated value to customers seeking advanced, cost-effective automotive electronic solutions.
